subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Community Preservation Act Appropriations
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review eleven project funding recommendations from the Community Preservation Committee for fiscal year 2026, totaling approximately $2.4 million. The committee voted to refer the entire funding package favorably to the regular City Council meeting.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 CPA Appropriation Requests Overview
items.summary: Theresa Dupont presented the overall requested Community Preservation Act appropriation of approximately $2.4 million spread over 11 community projects.

items.title: Mombo-Kett Field Scoreboard
items.summary: The committee discussed a $100,000 project to install a digital baseball scoreboard at Mombo-Kett Field in Playstead Park.

items.title: Tufts Park Field Lighting Improvements
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $432,000 proposal for new app-controlled Musco lighting at Tufts Park field number two.

items.title: Barry Park Community Garden
items.summary: A $57,500 request to construct a new community garden at Barry Park was discussed to address a 200-person waiting list.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Historic Section Access Road
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $35,000 request to add ADA parking to the design of the historic access road near the World War I memorial.

items.title: Brooks Estate Archaeological Survey
items.summary: A $10,000 grant request for a desktop archaeological survey at the Brooks Estate was discussed.

items.title: Brooks Estate ADA Parking and Pathways
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $602,000 request to fund ADA-compliant parking and pathways leading up to the Shepherd Brooks Manor.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Monument Restoration
items.summary: A $126,500 request to continue the restoration and cleaning of remaining monuments at the Cross Street Cemetery was discussed.

items.title: Housing Families Homelessness Prevention Program
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $75,000 request to fund eviction mitigation and legal aid services through Housing Families.

items.title: Medford Affordable Housing Trust Funding
items.summary: The committee discussed a $550,000 funding request for the Medford Affordable Housing Trust, representing 25 percent of the annual CPA budget.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Window Restoration
items.summary: A $150,000 request to fund the second phase of stained glass window restoration at Shiloh Baptist Church was discussed.

items.title: World War II Fountain Restoration
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $167,800 request to restore the non-functional World War II memorial fountain at Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Committee Recommendation and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee voted to favorably refer all fiscal year 2026 Community Preservation Committee appropriation recommendations to the regular council meeting, and adjourned.
